snippet.title: Eternity
snippet.description:
Eternity for PC: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/8027/eternity/index.html

Eternity for Mac: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/8256/mac/eternity/index.html

Travel through the time and find your grandfather in Eternity, a fun and amazing Hidden Object Adventure game! After inventing the time machine, your grandfather decided to experiment on himself and is sent hurtling through time. Use your courage and puzzle-solving skills to travel through time and find him somewhere in Eternity! Meet characters from all parts of the past and future, and solve perplexing puzzles.

  * Rich environment
  * Perplexing puzzles
  * Find your grandfather!
  * Check out our Blog Walkthrough at http://www.bigfishgames.com/blog/eternity-walkthrough/
  * Get the Strategy Guide at http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/8021/eternity-strategy-guide/index.html
